proposedMinimumModel.summary: Extend procedure evidence metadata and derivation policy without new assertion types. Gate 4 assertions unchanged. Compound behavior via optional keys + set-based derivation.
derivationRules: external_path_fault: component_verified at_load + valid path_open for same (componentId, loadInstanceKey)
path_open valid only if measurementContext.loadInCircuit===true and physicalTestSetup is not isolated_harness_pin_pin
Do not derive external_path_fault for direct_at_terminals interlock tests
Order of steps irrelevant for pairing (evidence set)

conceptInventory.problem: Distinguish multiple electrical loads sharing one componentId (cold/hot inlet coils; drain vs recirc on one connector).
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: Gate 4 pairs component_verified + path_open per componentId only; second coil overwrites or conflates evidence.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Optional procedure-local string on DiagnosticEffect + ScopedEvidenceRecord + PathFaultRef: loadInstanceKey (e.g. cold_coil, hot_coil, drain_winding). Not a canonical id.
conceptInventory.interactionWithGate4Semantics: Gate 4 witness unchanged when loadInstanceKey omitted (implicit default). Compound derivation groups by (componentId, loadInstanceKey).
conceptInventory.avoidsCanonicalTopologyPollution: Stays on procedure evidence records; never added to canonical ontology.
conceptInventory.intelligenceRankingImpact: Downstream interpretation only; no matcher/ranking changes in Gate 7.

conceptInventory.problem: ACU-first procedures prove load good after control/harness steps; causal conclusion must not require step order.
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: deriveForComponent implicitly allows any-order component_verified + path_open in one run, but repair headline and inconclusive rules treat missing load-before-path in OEM flow as ambiguous; multi-step seeds need documented set semantics.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Formalize: external_path_fault when ∃ loadInstance component_verified at_load AND ∃ path_open through_path with loadInCircuit=true for same (componentId, loadInstanceKey); ignore step order.
conceptInventory.interactionWithGate4Semantics: Identical to proven Gate 4 logic, explicitly documented and tested for reversed OEM order.
conceptInventory.avoidsCanonicalTopologyPollution: No change when only Gate 4 witnesses run.

conceptInventory.problem: One run may open multiple connector pin pairs (VCH7 cold and hot; dual pumps on J4).
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: pathRefs array exists but primary headline picks one conclusion; policy for multiple opens undefined.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Keep single DiagnosticConclusion per (componentId, loadInstanceKey) with pathRefs[]; primary resolver ranks external_path_fault and merges disjunctive headline.
conceptInventory.interactionWithGate4Semantics: Gate 4 single pathRef is pathRefs length 1.

conceptInventory.problem: Stateful/positional tests (float up/down, door open/closed, isolated harness) are not through_path Ω.
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: path_open requires loadInCircuit true; harness both-ends-open and door-state checkpoints are misclassified if forced into path_open.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Optional measurementContext.physicalTestSetup enum-like string: isolated_harness_pin_pin | positional_switch | direct_at_terminals | supply_voltage_segment. Gating rule: path_open only when setup is through_path_in_circuit.
conceptInventory.interactionWithGate4Semantics: Gate 4 uses through_path + loadInCircuit true; new setups block path_open eligibility.

conceptInventory.problem: Overfill procedure attributes float evidence to inlet_valve incorrectly; need repair target without new canonical node.
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: Single componentId on procedure forces wrong anchor for float P6 4&6 tests.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Optional evidenceSubjectKey on effect (procedure-local slug: fill_valve_coil, overfill_float). Maps to conclusion anchorComponentId + repairTargetHint, not ontology.
conceptInventory.interactionWithGate4Semantics: Gate 4 effects omit subject key → anchorComponentId only.

conceptInventory.problem: Distinguish replace component vs harness vs inspect circuit vs control output vs sub-load.
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: Headline uses external_path_fault generically; OEM has replace harness, replace float, suspect CCU.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Optional on DiagnosticConclusion: repairTargetHint (procedure-local enum strings). Repair UI unchanged in Gate 7 — headline text mapping only.
conceptInventory.interactionWithGate4Semantics: Gate 4 path-first headline maps from external_path_fault + hint default inspect_external_circuit.

conceptInventory.problem: Multiple conclusions in one run (valve good, float bad; drain path + recirc path).
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: resolvePrimaryDiagnosticConclusion picks one kind; disjunctive OEM not structured.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: Policy table: contradicted > component_failed > external_path_fault > inconclusive; optional disjunctiveHeadline when multiple external_path_fault instances.

conceptInventory.problem: ACU power test is voltage segmentation, not Ω path.
conceptInventory.whyCurrentModelCannotRepresent: supply confirm effects mix cord, RFI, harness; path_open inappropriate.
conceptInventory.minimumProposedRepresentation: measurementContext.modality: voltage | resistance on measurement steps; derivation branch supply_segment_fault (existing confirm) not external_path_fault.
